evidence.detail: The class owns a Set<NavigationButton> and an EventBus; registration ignores an already-present button and unregistration only acts when the button was registered.
Successful registration posts exact rs/runelite/events/NavigationButtonAdded carrying the same NavigationButton instance.
Successful unregistration posts exact rs/runelite/events/NavigationButtonRemoved carrying the same NavigationButton instance.
R147 ClientUI subscribes to those exact added/removed events to install or remove buttons from ClientToolbar/ClientTitleToolbar and to add/remove associated PluginPanel content.

candidates.note: NavigationButtonManager is fixed by its exact NavigationButton registry and EventBus add/remove event contract consumed by ClientUI. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The class extends R148 PluginPanel with the non-scroll-wrapped constructor and owns a CardLayout plus the current PluginPanel.
Its panel-selection method pushes a new PluginPanel when absent, shows it by identity-hash card key, and if a requested panel already exists deeper in the stack removes panels above it.
Its pop method reveals the previous PluginPanel and removes the current top panel, with exact assertion text 'Cannot pop last component' preventing removal of the root panel.
When active, panel transitions call PluginPanel deactivate/activate hooks; PluginPanelStack's own J_()/K_() lifecycle methods propagate to the current child.

candidates.note: PluginPanelStack is fixed by exact CardLayout push/pop semantics over PluginPanel instances plus lifecycle propagation. Confidence is 0.999.
